title: My family
somali: Magacaygu waa Cali. Waxaan la noolahay hooyaday, aabbahay iyo walaashay. Walaashay waa toban jir. Waxay jeceshahay buugaagta. Aabbahay dukaan ayuu ka shaqeeyaa. Hooyaday waa kalkaaliso caafimaad. Fiid kasta cashada ayaan wada cunnaa.
explanation: My name is Ali. I live with my mother, my father and my sister. My sister is ten years old. She likes books. My father works in a shop. My mother is a nurse. We eat dinner together every evening.
examples: shop: a place where you buy things
nurse: a person who helps sick people
together: with each other

exercises.prompt: Who works in a shop?
exercises.explain: The text says "My father works in a shop."
exercises.promptSo: Yaa ka shaqeeya dukaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Aabbaha Cali”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: How old is Ali's sister?
exercises.promptSo: Walaasha Cali imisa jir ayay tahay?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Toban”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: When does the family eat dinner together?
exercises.promptSo: Qoysku goorma ayay cashada wada cunaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Fiid kasta”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

examplesSo: dukaan: meel alaab laga iibsado

title: The weather today
somali: Maanta waa Isniin. Magaalada waa qabow oo dabayl badan. Cirku waa cirro. Saara waxay xidhataa jaakad diirran iyo koofiyad. Waxay qaadataa dallad, sababtoo ah galabta roob ayaa laga yaabaa inuu da’o. Berri cimilo qorrax leh ayaa jiri doonta.
explanation: Today is Monday. It is cold and windy in the city. The sky is grey. Sara wears a warm coat and a hat. She takes an umbrella because it may rain in the afternoon. Tomorrow will be sunny.
examples: windy: with a lot of wind
coat: warm clothing for outside
umbrella: used to stay dry in the rain

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Qabow oo dabayl leh”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.promptSo: Maxay Saara dallad u qaadanaysaa?

title: A trip to the coast
somali: Toddobaadkii hore dhammaadkiisii, Maxamed iyo saaxiibbadiis bas ayay xeebta ku tageen. Safarku wuxuu qaatay saddex saacadood, balse muuqaalka daaqadda laga arkayey wuxuu ahaa mid qurux badan. Waxay ku dabaasheen badda, kubbadna waxay ku ciyaareen ciidda, qadadana kalluun ayay cuneen. Fiidkii way daaleen, sidaas darteed baska ayay ku seexdeen intii ay guriga ku soo jireen.
explanation: Last weekend, Mohamed and his friends took a bus to the coast. The journey took three hours, but the view from the window was beautiful. They swam in the sea, played football on the sand and had fish for lunch. In the evening they were tired, so they slept on the bus all the way home.
examples: journey: a trip from one place to another
view: what you can see from a place
tired: needing rest or sleep

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Bas”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.promptSo: Maxay qadada cuneen?

title: Starting a new job
somali: Hodan waxay shaqadeeda cusub ee dukaan buugaagta lagu iibiyo bilowday Isniintii. Markii hore way welwelsanayd, sababtoo ah qofna ma ay aqoon. Maamulaha ayaa goobta tusay, wuxuuna baray shaqaalaha kale. Dhammaadkii maalinta waxay taqaanay sida loo isticmaalo mashiinka lacagta lagu diiwaangeliyo iyo meesha buugaagta carruurtu yaallaan. Waxay xiisaynaysaa inay berri shaqada ku soo noqoto.
explanation: Hodan started her new job at a bookshop on Monday. At first she was nervous because she did not know anyone. Her manager showed her around and introduced her to the team. By the end of the day she knew how to use the till and where the children's books were. She is looking forward to tomorrow.
examples: nervous: a little afraid or worried
manager: the person in charge of a team
till: the machine that records payments

exercises.prompt: Why was Hodan nervous?
exercises.promptSo: Maxay Hodan u walwalsanayd?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Cidna ma ay aqoon”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

title: The case for working from home
somali: Shirkado badan ayaa hadda shaqaalaha u oggolaada inay guriga ka shaqeeyaan ugu yaraan qayb ka mid ah toddobaadka. Dadka taageera arrintan waxay sheegaan inay kaydiso waqti iyo lacag, maadaama aan maalin kasta shaqada loo safri doonin, shaqaaluhuna badanaa sheegaan inay si fiican diiradda u saari karaan. Hase yeeshee, dadka dhaliila waxay ku doodaan in qofku dareemi karo kelinimo, isla markaana ay adkaan karto dhisidda isku-duubnida kooxda. Khubaro badan waxay ku talinayaan dheellitirnaan: maalmo guriga laga shaqeeyo iyo maalmo xafiiska la wada joogo.
explanation: Many companies now allow staff to work from home at least part of the week. Supporters say it saves time and money because there is no daily commute, and employees often report better concentration. However, critics argue that people can feel isolated and that it is harder to build team spirit. Most experts suggest a balance: a few days at home and a few days together in the office.
examples: commute: the regular journey to work
concentration: the ability to focus
isolated: feeling alone and separated from others

exercises.prompt: What is one advantage mentioned?
exercises.promptSo: Waa maxay hal faa’iido oo qoraalka lagu xusay?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Safar shaqo oo maalinle ah ma jiro”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.
optionsSo: Safar shaqo oo maalinle ah ma jiro

exercises.prompt: What do critics worry about?
exercises.explain: Critics mention isolation and team spirit.
exercises.promptSo: Maxay dadka dhaliila arrintani ka walaacsan yihiin?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Go’doon iyo niyadda kooxda”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: What do most experts recommend?
exercises.promptSo: Khubarada badankoodu maxay ku talinayaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Isku-dheellitirnaan”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

examplesSo: safar shaqo: socdaalka joogtada ah ee guriga iyo goobta shaqada u dhexeeya
diirad-saar: awoodda qofku wax ugu fiirsado
go’doonsan: dareemaya kelinimo iyo ka fogaansho dadka kale

title: Recycling in our town
somali: Sannadkii hore magaaladeennu waxay hirgelisay haamo kala gaar ah oo loogu talagalay waraaqaha, caagagga iyo qashinka cuntada. Markii hore dad badan oo deggan magaalada way ku wareereen, qaarna haamaha si khaldan ayay u isticmaaleen. Dabadeed golaha deegaanka ayaa guri kasta u diray waraaqo wargelin ah, wuxuuna qabtay kulammo gaagaaban oo xog-bixin ah. Tan iyo markaas, qashinka dib loo warshadeeyo ku dhowaad laba jibbaar ayuu noqday, magaaladuna waxay rajaynaysaa inay yoolkeeda gaadho labada sano ee soo socda.
explanation: Last year our town introduced separate bins for paper, plastic and food waste. At first many residents were confused, and some bins were used incorrectly. The council then sent leaflets to every home and organised short information sessions. Since then, the amount of recycled waste has almost doubled, and the town hopes to reach its target within two years.
examples: residents: people who live in a place
council: the local government
target: a goal you want to reach

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Way wareereen”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.promptSo: Golaha deegaanka sidee ayuu uga jawaabay?

optionsSo: Ku dhowaad laba jibbaar ayuu noqday

title: Why sleep matters
somali: Inkastoo dad badani hurdada u arkaan wax raaxo ah oo aan daruuri ahayn, cilmi-baadhisyadu si joogto ah ayay u muujinayaan inay muhiim u tahay xusuusta, niyadda iyo caafimaadka jirka. Inta lagu jiro hurdada qotada dheer, maskaxdu waxay xoojisaa oo habaysaa wixii aan maalintii barannay; taasina waa sababta ardayda seexata marka ay wax bartaan ka dib ay badanaa wax badan u xasuustaan. Dhanka kale, hurdo-yaraanta muddada dheer waxaa lala xiriiriyey difaaca jirka oo daciifa iyo awoodda diirad-saaridda oo yaraata. Sidaas darteed, khubaradu waxay dadka waaweyn kula taliyaan inay habeenkii seexdaan toddoba ilaa sagaal saacadood.
explanation: Although many people regard sleep as a luxury, research consistently shows that it is essential for memory, mood and physical health. During deep sleep the brain consolidates what we have learnt during the day, which is why students who sleep after studying often remember more. Chronic sleep deprivation, on the other hand, has been linked to weakened immunity and reduced concentration. Experts therefore advise adults to aim for seven to nine hours a night.
examples: consolidate: to make stronger and more stable
chronic: lasting for a long time
immunity: the body's ability to resist disease

exercises.prompt: According to the text, why do students benefit from sleeping after study?
options: The brain consolidates what they learnt
exercises.promptSo: Sida qoraalku sheegayo, maxay ardaydu uga faa’iidaystaan hurdada marka ay wax bartaan ka dib?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Maskaxdu waxay xoojisaa wixii ay barteen”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.
optionsSo: Maskaxdu waxay xoojisaa wixii ay barteen

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Difaaca jirka oo daciifa”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: How much sleep do experts advise for adults?
exercises.promptSo: Khubaradu dadka waaweyn imisa saacadood oo hurdo ah ayay kula talinayaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Toddoba ilaa sagaal saacadood”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

title: Cities and the cost of living
somali: Tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, kirada iyo kharashka guryaha ee magaalooyinka waaweyn ayaa aad uga dheereeyey kororka mushaharka. Sidaas darteed, xirfadlayaal badan oo dhallinyaro ah ayaa u guuray magaalooyin yaryar, halkaas oo kiradu ka jaban tahay, noloshuna ka deggan tahay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, magaalooyinku weli waxay soo jiitaan dadka raadinaya fursado shaqo iyo kala-duwanaansho dhaqameed. Qorsheeyayaasha magaalooyinku waxay ka digayaan in haddii aan la dhisin guryo qiimahoodu macquul yahay, magaalooyinku halis ugu jiraan inay noqdaan meelo ay dadka hodanka ahi oo keliya awoodaan inay ku noolaadaan.
explanation: Over the past decade, housing costs in major cities have risen far faster than wages. As a result, many young professionals have moved to smaller towns, where rents are lower and the pace of life is slower. Nevertheless, cities continue to attract those seeking career opportunities and cultural variety. Urban planners warn that unless more affordable homes are built, cities risk becoming accessible only to the wealthy.
examples: wages: money paid regularly for work
urban: relating to cities
affordable: not too expensive

exercises.explain: "housing costs ... risen far faster than wages"

optionsSo: Kirada oo jaban iyo nolol ka deggan meel kale

title: Automation and the future of work
somali: Rajada ah in mashiinnada otomaatiga ahi si baahsan u shaqayn doonaan waxay dhalisay walaac badan, hase yeeshee taariikhdu waxay muujinaysaa in isbeddelka tiknoolajiyaddu badanaa shaqada dib u qaabeeyo halkii uu gebi ahaanba baabi’in lahaa. Inkastoo hawlo joogto ah qaarkood mashiinno loo wareejinayo, haddana shaqooyin cusub ayaa soo baxaya, kuwaas oo inta badan u baahan xirfado jiilkii hore aan si fudud u qiyaasi karin. Sidaas darteed, su’aasha go’aamisa ma aha in shaqadu dhammaan doonto iyo in kale, balse waa in nidaamyada waxbarashadu dadka siin karaan qalabka iyo xirfadaha ay si dhakhso leh ula qabsan lahaayeen.
explanation: The prospect of widespread automation has provoked considerable anxiety, yet history suggests that technological change tends to reshape rather than simply eliminate employment. While certain routine tasks are indeed being delegated to machines, new roles continue to emerge, often requiring skills that were scarcely imaginable a generation ago. The decisive question, therefore, is not whether work will disappear but whether education systems can equip people to adapt swiftly enough.
examples: provoke: to cause a reaction
routine: regular and repeated, not creative
equip: to give someone what they need
swiftly: quickly

title: Why accents matter less than clarity
somali: Ardayda luqadaha barta badanaa waxay ka welwelaan in lahjaddoodu dadka tusayso inay ajnabi yihiin, qaarna dadaal badan ayay geliyaan sidii ay lahjadda uga takhalusi lahaayeen. Hase yeeshee, khubarada luqaddu waxay adkaynayaan in waxa isfahamka suurtageliya ay tahay hadalka si fudud loo fahmi karo, ee aanay ahayn in qofku u dhawaaqo sida qof afka hooyo ku hadla. Qof lahjad muuqata leh oo si cad u dhawaaqa, fikradihiisana si nidaamsan u cabbira, guud ahaan si ka wanaagsan ayaa loo fahmaa marka loo eego qof afka hooyo ku hadla oo hadalkiisa liqa. Sidaas darteed, yoolka waxtarka badan waa hadal cad oo kalsooni leh.
explanation: Learners frequently worry that their accent will mark them out as foreigners, and some invest enormous effort in eliminating it. Linguists, however, emphasise that intelligibility, not nativeness, is what ensures successful communication. A speaker with a pronounced accent who articulates clearly and structures ideas coherently will generally be understood far better than a native speaker who mumbles. The more productive goal is therefore clear, confident speech.
examples: intelligibility: how easily speech can be understood
pronounced: very noticeable
articulate: to speak clearly
coherently: in a logical, connected way

exercises.prompt: What do linguists emphasise?
exercises.promptSo: Aqoonyahannada luuqaduhu maxay xoogga saarayaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Faham-fudaydka hadalka”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: Who may be understood better?

optionsSo: Qof lahjad leh oo si cad u hadlaya

title: The quiet power of understatement
somali: Dhaqanka Ingiriiska ee waxyaabaha waaweyn si yar loo sheego, oo dadka dibadda ka yimaadaa marar badan si khaldan u fahmaan, wuxuu leeyahay shaqo bulsheed oo xeeladaysan: marka qofku si ula kac ah u yareeyo culayska dhacdo, wuxuu muujinayaa degganaansho, wuxuuna dhegaystaha ku dhiirrigeliyaa inuu fahmo baaxadda dhabta ah. Sidaas darteed, masiibo weyn oo dib u dhac ah in lagu tilmaamo “wax yar oo dhib ah” ma aha been-sheegid, balse waa hab dhaqan oo lagu muujiyo is-xakamayn. Dhibaatada ardayda luqaddu waxay tahay in erayada tooska ah iyo macnaha loola jeedo ay kala duwanaan karaan; macnaha guud ee dhaqanka ay wadaagaan dadka hadlaya oo keliya ayaa buuxiya farqigaas.
explanation: British understatement, so often misread by outsiders, performs a subtle social function: by deliberately minimising the gravity of an event, the speaker signals composure and invites the listener to infer the true magnitude. To describe a catastrophic delay as 'a bit of an inconvenience' is thus not dishonesty but a ritual of restraint. The difficulty for learners lies in the fact that the literal words and the intended meaning diverge, and only shared cultural context bridges the gap.
examples: understatement: saying something is less important than it is
gravity: seriousness
composure: calmness
diverge: to become different
